# http2

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/pkg/v1/net/http2"
```

Package http2 serves HTTP/2 beside HTTP/1.1 on the SDK's loop engine (ADR 0221): HandleLoop adapts a Handler of package http1 to a loop group, the connection's first bytes choosing the version, so one chain of Routes, Bearer, Headers and Log serves both. h2c by prior knowledge, or h2 over TLS (ADR 0198); the Upgrade: h2c form is not served.

<a name="HandleLoop"></a>
## func [HandleLoop](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/net/http2/gen_facade.go>)

```go
func HandleLoop(h corenet.HTTP1Handler, p http1.Parser) *LoopHandler
```

HandleLoop adapts h to the loop engine for HTTP/2 beside HTTP/1.1, each connection's first bytes deciding its version. p frames HTTP/1.1 requests and bounds both versions' heads; the zero Parser is the profile's defaults.

Draining implements corenet.LoopHTTPCodec, on the goroutine that drains the group: each lane is told through its own thread, and writes GOAWAY(NO\_ERROR) on every HTTP/2 connection it holds.

<a name="LoopHandler.OnDone"></a>
### func \(LoopHandler\) [OnDone](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/net/http2/loop_pending.go>)

```go
func (*LoopHandler) OnDone(io corenet.LoopIO, job corenet.LoopJobValue)
```

OnDone implements corenet.LoopOffloader, on the lane's thread: a job has come back. An HTTP/2 answer is written at once, the streams being independent; one whose stream or connection ended is dropped and its slot freed, the reset path.
